title: attempt.json
description: One attempt of a cubetrace session, schema version 2 (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §7; version 1 is attempt.v1.schema.json). Times are host milliseconds (performance.timeOrigin + performance.now() on the host device), except cubeMs, the cube's own clock. The fields of T3.7 (app, gyro, resyncs, the moves' serial and packetLast) are optional: the files written before have none.

session.description: The id of the session: a lowercase UUID v4.

index.description: The attempt's 1-based position in its session.

app.description: The build that wrote the record (T3.7). Absent from the files written before.

scramble.description: Face turns separated by single spaces (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §2).

scrambledFacelets.description: The scramble applied to a solved cube: the state at scrambleDone.

crossFace.description: The face whose cross completed first (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §4); null if none did.

events.description: The events of docs/DATA-MODEL.md §3; null when they did not happen.

moves.description: Every move the cube reported, in order, corrections of a mis-scramble included.

clock.description: The cube clock fit of this attempt, host ≈ a·cube + b, by least squares over its moves that ended their Bluetooth packet, from its first move to solveEnd or the DNF (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §7, docs/DEVICES.md); null without two of them at different cube times.

residualP95Ms.description: 95th percentile (nearest rank) of the absolute residuals of the samples (the last 2000 if there are more).

timeMs.description: solveEnd − solveStart; null on a DNF.

inspectionMs.description: solveStart − (pickup ?? scrambleDone); null if the solve did not start.

movesQtm.description: Quarter turns of the solve's moves (a half turn counts two).

tps.description: movesQtm / (timeMs / 1000), rounded to two decimals; null without a time.

replayOk.description: The solve's moves take scrambledFacelets to solved in the simulator.

scrambleCorrected.description: The cube left the scramble's path during the scramble.

scrambleExtraMoves.description: Moves made during the scramble beyond the scramble's own, in quarter turns: one wrong quarter turn undone counts 2.

phases.description: The CFOP phases completed, in order (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §4): all eight for a solve its moves replay.

video.description: The video clips of the attempt: one per camera and segment (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §7).

gyro.description: The attempt's gyroscope file, gyro.json in its folder (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §11, T3.7): its name, its samples, the host times of its first and last samples, their rate, and whether it begins later than the window asked for; null without one (a cube without a gyroscope, no sample in the window). Absent from the files written before it existed, which read as null.

file.description: The file's name in the attempt's folder.

fromHostMs.description: The host time of the first sample.

toHostMs.description: The host time of the last sample.

rateHz.description: The samples per second over the file, to one decimal; 0 with fewer than two samples.

truncatedStart.description: The buffer did not reach back to the window's start (2 s before the first scramble turn): the file begins at its oldest sample.

resyncs.description: The states the app adopted from the cube's reports after moves went unseen (T3.7), in order; empty when none. Absent from the files written before it existed, which read as empty.

facelets.description: A cube state: 54 stickers in Kociemba order (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §2).

serial.description: The cube's move counter, 0–255, wrapping (T3.7); null for a source without one. Absent from the files written before.

packetLast.description: The move was the newest of its Bluetooth packet, the one whose arrival its hostMs measures (T3.7): the older moves of a packet share its time. Absent from the files written before.

resync.description: A state the cube reported that differed from the one the app knew, and which the app adopted (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §7, T3.7).

hostMs.description: When the cube reported it, on the host clock.

state.description: The attempt's state when the report came, during which moves went unseen.

slot.description: F2L phases only: the pair's slot, named by its middle-layer edge position.

cameraLabel.description: A camera's label, unique within its session: lowercase letters and digits in words joined by hyphens (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §5).

crop.description: The framing rectangle in whole pixels of the camera's frames, as recorded (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §6); null for the whole frame.

clip.description: One video clip of the attempt, in the attempt's folder (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §5 and §7).

codec.description: The video codec string, such as avc1.640028.

audio.description: The audio codec string, such as mp4a.40.2; null without an audio track.

crop.description: The framing rectangle when the clip was recorded; null for the whole frame.

fpsNominal.description: The frame rate the camera's track reported.

frames.description: The number of frames in the clip.

firstFrameHostMs.description: The host time of the clip's first frame: t0HostMs of its frames file.

syncResidualMs.description: How far the camera lagged the cube when the clip was recorded: offsetMs of the camera's clock in session.json; null before a sync check.

truncatedStart.description: The clip begins later than asked, at the oldest keyframe in memory: the start asked for was older than the capture's buffer (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §7). Absent from the files written before it existed, which read as false.

local.description: False once the MP4 is no longer on the device that recorded it: deleted after its upload was confirmed, it is in the dataset's bucket (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §7, T3.3); its frames file stays. Absent while the file is there, which true means too, and in the uploaded attempt.json. Written by the builds before T4.2a only: since then the device keeps this to itself (uploads.json and the attempt's folder), and the record does not change when a clip leaves the device.

app.description: The build of the app that wrote the file: the version of the root package.json and the short SHA of its commit (session.json has had it since version 1; the other files since T3.7, so those written before have none).

commit.description: Short SHA of the build's commit.
